pages.text: The launcher is the only thing you install. It keeps your mods identical to the server's, so "mismatched mods" can't happen, and it updates itself.

pages.title: Home
pages.text: The Play button, the server's status and player list, and news from the pack's admins. When a pack update is out, the Play button says so and installs it before launching.

pages.title: Mods
pages.text: The full list of mods with a link to each one's Modrinth page. Mods marked $(bold)Optional$() are client-side extras you can switch off (shaders, first-person model, controller support…). Everything else is required by the server.

pages.title: Settings
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Memory:$() how much RAM Minecraft gets. The server recommends 6 GB; more helps with shaders.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Window size / fullscreen.$()$(br)$(li)$(bold)Join the server automatically:$() skips the title screen.$(br)$(li)$(bold)When the game starts:$() minimise, keep or close the launcher.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Java executable / JVM arguments:$() leave empty unless you know why.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Files & repair:$() opens the game, screenshots and logs folders. $(italic)Repair & play$() re-checks every file and re-downloads anything damaged.

pages.title: Where things are
pages.text: Everything lives in $(#e0ac46)%APPDATA%\LemurSaucePacket$(): $(#e0ac46)instance$() is the game folder (screenshots, logs, options), $(#e0ac46)minecraft$() and $(#e0ac46)runtime$() are the game and Java files it manages.

pages.title: Updates
pages.text: The launcher checks GitHub Releases on start. When a new version has downloaded, a "Restart to update" chip appears in the title bar.
